items.glossEn: Joseph. Compare H3084 (יְהוֹסֵף).
items.defEn: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites

items.glossEn: add, [idiom] again, [idiom] any more, [idiom] cease, [idiom] come more, [phrase] conceive again, continue, exceed, [idiom] further, [idiom] gather together, get more, give more-over, [idiom] henceforth, increase (more and more), join, [idiom] longer (bring, do, make, much, put), [idiom] (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, [idiom] yet, yield.
items.defEn: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)

items.glossEn: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.
items.defEn: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)

items.glossEn: desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly))
items.defEn: to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas G1014 (βούλομαι) properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or pref

items.glossEn: gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.
items.defEn: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)

items.glossEn: (be-) love(-d, -ly, -r), like, friend.
items.defEn: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)

items.glossEn: be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power
items.defEn: to be able or possible

items.glossEn: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, [idiom] fully, [idiom] have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.
items.defEn: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)

items.glossEn: [idiom] at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory.
items.defEn: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor

items.glossEn: just, lawful, righteous (man).
items.defEn: just

items.glossEn: describe, write(-ing, -ten)
items.defEn: to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe

items.glossEn: [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule.
items.defEn: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: ark, chest, coffin.
items.defEn: a box

items.glossEn: assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), [idiom] generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, [idiom] surely, take (away, into, up), [idiom] utterly, withdraw.
items.defEn: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)

items.glossEn: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.
items.defEn: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apar

items.glossEn: law
items.defEn: law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle)

items.glossEn: Jew(-ess), of Judæa
items.defEn: Judæan, i.e. belonging to Jehudah

items.glossEn: X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through)
items.defEn: to enter (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.
items.defEn: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)

items.glossEn: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
items.defEn: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power

items.glossEn: anointing, [idiom] fat (things), [idiom] fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive, [phrase] pine.
items.defEn: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness

items.glossEn: court, tower, village.
items.defEn: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)

items.glossEn: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.
items.defEn: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: beast, cattle.
items.defEn: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)

items.glossEn: brother, companion, fellow, friend, husband, lover, neighbour, [idiom] (an-) other.
items.defEn: an associate (more or less close)

items.glossEn: adorning, world
items.defEn: orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally))

items.glossEn: mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.
items.defEn: properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree

items.glossEn: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.
items.defEn: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)

items.glossEn: [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.
items.defEn: to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal

items.glossEn: bill, book, evidence, [idiom] learn(-ed) (-ing), letter, register, scroll.
items.defEn: properly, writing (the art or a document); by implication, a book

items.glossEn: adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for H7646 (שָׂבַע)), take an oath, [idiom] straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.
items.defEn: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)

items.glossEn: angel, messenger
items.defEn: compare G34 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor

items.glossEn: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.
items.defEn: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)

items.glossEn: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.
items.defEn: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd

items.glossEn: Jordan.
items.defEn: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine

items.glossEn: (which was) commanded(-ment), law, ordinance, precept.
items.defEn: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)

items.glossEn: Moab.
items.defEn: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants

items.glossEn: hand
items.defEn: the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument)

items.glossEn: Ephraim, Ephraimites.
items.defEn: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory

items.glossEn: king, royal.
items.defEn: a king

items.glossEn: aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.
items.defEn: old

items.glossEn: find, get, obtain, perceive, see
items.defEn: to find (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).
items.defEn: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)

items.glossEn: deed, doing, labour, work
items.defEn: toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act

items.glossEn: company, multitude, number (of people), people, press
items.defEn: a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot

items.glossEn: ten, (fif-, seven-) teen.
items.defEn: ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits)

items.glossEn: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.
items.defEn: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)

items.glossEn: Abraham.
items.defEn: Abraham, the later name of Abram

items.glossEn: offence, sin(-ful)
items.defEn: a sin (properly abstract)
